Advanced ATC

基于时间的间隔

A separation technique in which aircraft are spaced by time intervals instead of distance to maximize runway throughput, especially in strong headwind conditions (ICAO Doc 4444, SESAR).

Quick answer: A separation technique in which aircraft are spaced by time intervals instead of distance to maximize runway throughput, especially in strong headwind conditions (ICAO Doc 4444, SESAR).
